<?php
namespace App;
class Branch {
 public function run(Port $port, bool $flag) {
  $x = new Service;
  $x->before();
  if ($flag) { $x = new Other; $x->inside(); } else { $x->otherwise(); }
  $x->after();
  $port->send($x);
  $x->afterArgument();
  foreach ([1] as $item) { $port = new Other; $port->loop(); }
  $port->afterLoop();
  $callback = function (Service $service) use ($port) { $service->run(); return $port; };
  return $callback;
 }
}
function run(Port $port) { $port->send(); }
run(new Service);
